text: Final Income Items Enter any of these final income items you or Casey received in 2025. NOL carryover not on a K-1 LEARN MORE (Enter as negative) Gambling income not on a W-2G or K-1 Nonprofessional fiduciary fees Not-for-profit rental of residential property Digital assets received as ordinary income not reported elsewhere.
